allow.rounds: [RoundSummary + startInMinutes + openedAt + createdAt + resultWindowEndsAt + startOverdue + readiness] (D-53)

readiness.startOverdue: bool (always false since D-53: there is no LOCKED state)
readiness.startBlocked: bool (D-53: the start time passed but the pool was under 5; cleared when the start time changes)
readiness.unfinishedBoards: int (D-53: DRAFT boards plus players who joined since opening without a board; 0 unless REGISTRATION_OPEN)

allow.testMode: bool (D-56: test mode is on for this event; Mission Control shows a reminder banner)
allow.testModeLocked: bool (D-56: BINGO_ALLOW_RESET=off; test mode cannot be turned on)
allow.canClearData: bool (D-53, D-56: test mode on and not locked; the Clear all data action is hidden otherwise)

note: Winner display labels are visible to admins (requirement 3). Individual boards are never listed; Mission Control is operational, Insights are separate (A-08).
